prompt: Create a high fidelity desktop homepage mockup for Mag. Romina Lauzensky, psychotherapist in Vienna and Mödling. Render a wide landscape website edge to edge with crisp readable German text, no browser frame or device. Visitors need to see Romina, understand her person-centered offer, and start a confidential contact. Use the attached real portrait and practice-room photos as faithful references; no invented people or interiors. This is the already chosen Quiet Threshold visual world: warm plaster, daylight, deep green-gray, muted celadon from the chair, one restrained terracotta accent, humanist serif headlines, clear sans for controls. Explore a stronger architectural composition than a standard hero. Let a tall photographed doorway or room opening dominate the central visual structure as the page's single spatial move; arrange the welcome statement and the first-contact fields as legible surfaces of that same threshold, not as floating generic cards. Keep the photo recognizably original and the text unobscured. Show the real message “Gemeinsam schaffen wir Raum für Entwicklung, Lebensfreude und innere Stabilität.” Show Mag. Romina Lauzensky, Home, Therapeutisches Angebot, Rahmenbedingungen, Über mich, Kontakt, and DE / EN. A visible working-looking contact area includes Name, E-Mail, Nachricht and “Kontakt aufnehmen”; if direct details appear, use only praxis@psychotherapie-lauzensky.at and 0681/840 870 22. The first viewport should reveal the beginning of a therapeutic offer section beneath it. Make the layout emotionally steady, approachable, and distinctly architectural. The final build uses the source image files unchanged. Do not add medical promises, testimonials, fees, availability, or unverified services.
note: Illustrative comp; original image files will be used unchanged in the live site. The doorway frame will be built around the original photograph rather than replacing it.
